verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own copy names this story's exact scenarios: "a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once", created by asking Ari in one line. It also says you can see what a hire, price change or cut does before you commit, and the pricing page lists unlimited models and scenarios. Side-by-side comparison is only implied by "several at once" and is never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented side-by-side scenario comparison view, in-depth scenario documentation beyond marketing and llms.txt lines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
